title: DengAI Reproducibility and Benchmark Provenance Release
description: Reproducibility and provenance release for the climate-coupled variable-order fractional dengue manuscript. The package preserves source-derived cohort reconstruction logic, frozen Gradient Boosting configuration, archived benchmark metrics, selected Stage-6 diagnostics, and explicit reproducibility limitations. The historical 1,352 x 66 processed benchmark artifact and complete original feature-generation pipeline were not recovered and are therefore not represented as exactly rerunnable in this release.
